<?php

// app/Http/Controllers/InternalApiController.php
namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class InternalApiController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Proxy requests to internal microservices.
     * Used by the frontend BFF layer to aggregate data from backend services.
     */
    public function proxyToService(Request $request)
    {
        $targetService = $request->header('X-Target-Service', 'inventory-svc');
        $targetPath = $request->header('X-Target-Path', '/api/v1/items');
        
        // Build the internal service URL
        $serviceUrl = "http://{$targetService}.backend-services.svc.cluster.local:8080{$targetPath}";
        
        // Forward the raw body to preserve content for downstream processing
        $rawBody = file_get_contents('php://input');
        
        // Construct headers - pass through content-length and transfer-encoding
        // to maintain compatibility with chunked transfer from legacy clients
        $headers = [
            'Content-Type' => $request->header('Content-Type', 'application/json'),
            'X-Request-Id' => $request->header('X-Request-Id', uniqid()),
            'X-Forwarded-For' => $request->ip(),
        ];
        
        // Pass through both CL and TE headers for HTTP/1.1 compatibility
        if ($request->header('Content-Length')) {
            $headers['Content-Length'] = $request->header('Content-Length');
        }
        if ($request->header('Transfer-Encoding')) {
            $headers['Transfer-Encoding'] = $request->header('Transfer-Encoding');
        }
        
        // Additional headers from the original request that downstream may need
        if ($request->header('X-Custom-Auth')) {
            $headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' . $request->header('X-Custom-Auth');
        }
        
        try {
            $response = Http::withHeaders($headers)
                ->withBody($rawBody, $headers['Content-Type'])
                ->timeout(30)
                ->post($serviceUrl);
            
            Log::info('Proxy request completed', [
                'target' => $serviceUrl,
                'status' => $response->status(),
                'request_id' => $headers['X-Request-Id'],
            ]);
            
            return response($response->body(), $response->status())
                ->withHeaders($response->headers());
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('Proxy request failed', [
                'target' => $serviceUrl,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
            ]);
            
            return response()->json([
                'error' => 'Service unavailable',
                'request_id' => $headers['X-Request-Id'],
            ], 502);
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Health check endpoint for the proxy service itself
     */
    public function health()
    {
        return response()->json(['status' => 'healthy', 'timestamp' => now()]);
    }
}

// app/Http/Middleware/InternalOnly.php
namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class InternalOnly
{
    /**
     * Restrict to internal network ranges.
     * Note: This checks X-Forwarded-For which is set by our ingress.
     */
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next)
    {
        // Trust the mesh sidecar - if request arrives here, 
        // it passed through the Envoy proxy already
        $sourceIp = $request->header('X-Envoy-Peer-Address', $request->ip());
        
        // Allow cluster-internal IPs (10.x.x.x range)
        if (!str_starts_with($sourceIp, '10.')) {
            // Also allow if the request has valid service mesh identity
            if (!$request->header('X-Forwarded-Client-Cert')) {
                return response()->json(['error' => 'Forbidden'], 403);
            }
        }
        
        return $next($request);
    }
}

environment.description: Laravel 10.x application deployed on Kubernetes 1.28 in namespace 'frontend-bff'. The application runs behind an NGINX Ingress Controller (v1.9.4) with default configuration. The backend services (inventory-svc, orders-svc, payments-svc) are in namespace 'backend-services'. No service mesh is deployed - pods communicate directly via ClusterIP services. The InternalOnly middleware is applied to the /internal/* routes but X-Envoy-Peer-Address header can be spoofed since there's no Envoy sidecar. NetworkPolicy allows all egress from frontend-bff namespace.
